subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is NOT correct about the procedure of calculating balancing of crankshaft of an engine?

options.text: It involves determining the balancing couple and counterweight mass required to balance the crankshaft.
Crankshaft balancing involves calculating the rotating and reciprocating masses of a crankshaft.
To balance a crankshaft, metal can be removed by drilling holes on the 'heavy' side until balance is achieved.
To balance a crankshaft, metal can be added by welding material deposition on the 'heavy' side until balance is achieved.

solution:
The correct answer is __To balance a crankshaft, metal can be added by welding material deposition on the 'heavy' side until balance is achieved.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Balancing of a crankshaft__ is a critical process for ensuring smooth engine operation.
 
• It involves determining the balancing couple and counterweight mass required to balance the crankshaft.
 
• Crankshaft balancing includes calculating the rotating and reciprocating masses of the crankshaft.
 
• To balance a crankshaft, metal can be removed by drilling holes on the 'heavy' side until balance is achieved.
 
• However, metal cannot be added by welding on the 'heavy' side for balancing purposes, as this can compromise the crankshaft's integrity.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Importance of crankshaft balancing:**

 
 
• Prevents engine vibrations and reduces wear and tear on engine components.
 
• Enhances engine efficiency and performance.
 
 
 
• **Methods of balancing:**
 
 
• Static balancing: Ensures the crankshaft doesn't rotate under its own weight when placed on knife edges.
 
• Dynamic balancing: Ensures the crankshaft remains balanced while rotating at high speeds.
